524	    def reread(self, item: Item, r: dict) -> dict:
525	        """One action: re-read a target. Returns {refused, readings: {entity: value read}, ok: the item's sum holds}."""
526	        t, dpi, asked = r["target"], r["dpi"], r["model"]
527	        item.actions += 1
528	        tk = (item.page, item.block, tkey(t))
529	        tried = self.rungs.setdefault(tk, set())
530	        step, why = pick_model(asked, self.ladder, tried)
531	        model = self.ladder[step] if step is not None else norm(asked)
532	        if why is None and (*tk, model, dpi) in self.done_reads:
533	            why = f"{_tdesc(t)} has already been re-read with {model} at {dpi} dpi"
534	        why = why or self._target_refusal(item, t)
535	        if why:
536	            return self._refuse(item, t, dpi, model, why)
537	        self.n_crops += 1
538	        dest = self.crop_dir / f"reread-{self.n_crops:04d}-{item.block}.png"
539	        name = {"cell": "reread_cell", "column": "reread_column", "row_strip": "reread_strip"}.get(t["kind"], "reread_total")
540	        cell_tag = f"{t.get('row', '')}/{t.get('column', '')}".strip("/") or None
541	        with tracing.trace(name, kind="TOOL", run=self.run_id, county=self.county, page=item.page, block=item.block,
542	                           cell=cell_tag, target=t["kind"], dpi=dpi, model=model) as sp:
543	            try:
544	                if t["kind"] == "row_strip":
545	                    pieces = self.geo.strip_crops(item.page, item.block, t["row"], dpi, dest, STRIP_CELLS)
546	                else:
547	                    path, box = self.geo.crop(item.page, item.block, t, dpi, dest)
548	                    pieces = None
549	            except GeometryError as e:
550	                return self._refuse(item, t, dpi, model, f"no crop: {e}")
551	            tried.add(step)
552	            self.done_reads.add((*tk, model, dpi))
553	            if pieces is None:
554	                sp.set_attribute("crop_path", str(path))
555	                prompt = READ_PROMPTS[t["kind"]].format(**{"row": t.get("row"), "column": t.get("column")})
556	                ans = self.gw.ask_json(prompt, path, validate=read_validator(t["kind"]), model=model)
557	                crops = str(path)
558	            else:
559	                strip = {}
560	                for pth, cols, bx in pieces:
561	                    prompt = READ_PROMPTS["row_strip"].format(row=t["row"], n=len(cols), columns=", ".join(cols))
562	                    a = self.gw.ask_json(prompt, pth, validate=read_validator("row_strip", len(cols)), model=model)
563	                    strip.update(zip(cols, a["values"]))
564	                ans, crops = {"strip": strip}, [str(p_) for p_, _, _ in pieces]
565	                box = (min(b_[0] for _, _, b_ in pieces), min(b_[1] for _, _, b_ in pieces),
566	                       max(b_[2] for _, _, b_ in pieces), max(b_[3] for _, _, b_ in pieces))
567	        ups = self._updates(item, t, ans, model)
568	        settle(self.led, self.county, ups, self.seen)
569	        for u in ups:
570	            self.seen.setdefault(u["entity"], []).append(u["new"])
571	            self.reread_entities.add(u["entity"])
572	        self.sync_status()
573	        with tracing.trace("check_sums", kind="TOOL", run=self.run_id, county=self.county, page=item.page,
574	                           block=item.block):
575	            me = self.item_check(item)
576	        ok = bool(me and me.ok)
577	        changes = [{"what": u["label"], "entity": list(u["entity"]), "old": u["old"], "new": u["new"],
578	                    "kept": u["kept"], "sums_hold_old": u.get("sums_hold_old"), "sums_hold_new": u.get("sums_hold_new")}
579	                   for u in ups]
580	        self.ev("reread", item=item.id, page=item.page, block=item.block, target=t, model=model, dpi=dpi, box=list(box),
581	                crop=crops, ladder_step=step, changes=changes)
582	        self.ev("check", item=item.id, page=item.page, block=item.block, sum_kind=item.kind, key=item.key, ok=ok,
583	                computed=me.computed if me else None, printed=me.printed if me else None,
584	                failing_in_block=sum(1 for c in self.checks_now() if c.block_id == item.block and not c.ok))
585	        item.history.append(f"re-read {_tdesc(t)} at {dpi} dpi with {model}: " +
586	                            ("; ".join(f"{c['what']} {c['old']} -> {c['new']} ({'kept new' if c['kept'] == 'new' else 'kept old'})"
587	                                       for c in changes if c["old"] != c["new"]) or "read the same values") +
588	                            f"; this sum now {'holds' if ok else 'still fails'}")
589	        self.log(f"    {_tdesc(t)} {dpi} dpi {model}: {'holds' if ok else 'still fails'}")
590	        return {"refused": None, "readings": {u["entity"]: u["new"] for u in ups}, "ok": ok}

593	    def give_verdict(self, sums, verdict, reason, entity=None):
594	        """Every sum that stays failing gets a verdict and a reason. A cell that is the located value gets the status."""
595	        for ch in sums:
596	            self.led.set_verdict(self.county, sum_id(ch), ch.page, ch.block_id, verdict, reason, list(entity) if entity else None)
597	        if entity and entity[2] not in ("row", "col", "grand"):
598	            self.led.set_status(self.county, *entity, verdict, reason)
599	            self.ev("status_change", changes=[{"cell": list(entity), "old": "open", "new": verdict, "reason": reason}])
600	        self.ev("verdict", sums=[sum_id(c) for c in sums], verdict=verdict, reason=reason,
601	                entity=list(entity) if entity else None)

603	    # -- a located value
604	    def work_suspect(self, s: checks.Suspect):
605	        first = s.sums[0]
606	        item = Item(first.kind, first.page, first.block_id, first.key)
607	        ids = [sum_id(c) for c in s.sums]
608	        ent, t = entity_of(s.entity), target_of(s.entity)
609	        self.handled.add(s.entity)
610	        self.ev("item_start", item=item.id, page=item.page, block=item.block)
611	        self.ev("suspect", item=item.id, sums=ids, entity=list(s.entity), read=s.read, would_be=s.would_be)
612	        self.log(f"    suspect {s.entity}: read {s.read}, the sums need {s.would_be}")
613	        readings, result, last = [], None, None
614	        for step in range(len(self.ladder)):
615	            if item.actions >= MAX_ACTIONS:
616	                break
617	            last = self.reread(item, {"target": t, "dpi": SUSPECT_DPI, "model": self.ladder[step]})
618	            if last["refused"]:
619	                break
620	            now = {_ck(c): c for c in self.checks_now()}
621	            if all(now.get(_ck(c)) is None or now[_ck(c)].ok for c in s.sums):
622	                result = "holds"
623	                break
624	            rd = last["readings"].get(ent)
625	            readings.append((self.ladder[step], rd))
626	            vals = [v for _, v in readings]
627	            if rd is not None and rd in vals[:-1]:
628	                result = "document_inconsistent"
629	                break
630	        now = {_ck(c): c for c in self.checks_now()}
631	        sums_now = [now[_ck(c)] for c in s.sums if _ck(c) in now]
632	        if result == "holds":
633	            self.ev("item_end", item=item.id, result="holds")
634	            return
635	        seen = ", ".join(f"{m} read {v}" for m, v in readings)
636	        if result == "document_inconsistent":
637	            why = (f"the scan shows {readings[-1][1]} there on every re-read ({seen}) while both sums it sits on still "
638	                   f"fail: {describe(sums_now[0])}; and {describe(sums_now[1])}. The document disagrees with itself.")
639	            self.give_verdict(sums_now, "document_inconsistent", why, s.entity)
640	            self.ev("item_end", item=item.id, result="document_inconsistent")
641	        else:
642	            why = ((f"re-reads ({seen}) did not settle it" if readings else f"no re-read was possible ({last and last['refused']})")
643	                   + f": {describe(sums_now[0])}; and {describe(sums_now[1])}")
644	            self.give_verdict(sums_now, "cannot_verify", why, s.entity)
645	            self.ev("item_end", item=item.id, result="cannot_verify")
646	
647	    # -- one item the model decides
648	    def stop(self, item, reason):
649	        chs = self.checks_now()
650	        me = next((c for c in chs if _ck(c) == (item.kind, item.page, item.block, item.key)), None)
651	        marked = []
652	        if me and not me.ok:
653	            if not me.kind.startswith("grand"):
654	                cells, totals = self.led.cells(self.county), self.led.totals(self.county)
655	                on = checks.crossing(cells, totals)
656	                by = {_ckey(c): c for c in cells}
657	                up = self.given_up()
658	                vids = {v["sum_id"] for v in self.led.verdicts(self.county)}
659	                for k, _ in me.terms:

682	    def _work(self, item: Item):
683	        self.ev("item_start", item=item.id, page=item.page, block=item.block)
684	        while True:
685	            me = self.item_check(item)
686	            if me is None or me.ok:
687	                self.ev("item_end", item=item.id, result="holds")
688	                return

699	                self.ev("item_end", item=item.id, result="cannot_verify")
700	                return

702	            if d["action"] == "cannot_verify":

704	                self.ev("item_end", item=item.id, result="cannot_verify")
705	                return

708	                self.ev("item_end", item=item.id, result="cannot_verify")
709	                return
710	            for r in d["rereads"]:
711	                if item.actions >= MAX_ACTIONS:
712	                    break

714	                me = self.item_check(item)
715	                if me is None or me.ok:

723	def work_list(chs, done_ids: set, given_up: set = frozenset()) -> list[Item]:
724	    """Failing sums, grouped by block (page order), rows then columns then the grand totals within a block.
725	    A sum is left out when it was worked before (or has a verdict: `done_ids`) or a value on it is already given up on
726	    (`given_up`): the sum cannot be made to hold without that value."""
727	    items = [Item(c.kind, c.page, c.block_id, c.key) for c in chs if not c.ok and sum_id(c) not in done_ids and
728	             not any(k in given_up for k, _ in c.terms) and (c.printed_key not in given_up)]
729	    items.sort(key=lambda i: (i.page, _block_no(i.block), ORDER[i.kind], i.key))

741	def close_county(county, gw, led, geo, *, run_id="", max_items=None, log=print, crop_dir=None, reader=None,
742	                 pair=True) -> dict:
743	    """Work every failing sum of a county's ledger. Returns the summary figures (also written as events)."""
744	    t0 = time.time()
745	    c0, p0 = gw.calls, (gw.prompt_tokens, gw.completion_tokens, gw.cost)
746	    cl = Closer(county, gw, led, geo, run_id=run_id, crop_dir=crop_dir, log=log, reader=reader, pair=pair)
747	    before = count_failing(cl.checks_now())
748	    first = {_ckey(c): c["value"] for c in led.cells(county)}
749	    first_totals = {(t["page"], t["block_id"], t["direction"], t["key"]): t["value"] for t in led.totals(county)}
750	    stopped = None
751	    done_ids = {json.loads(e["payload_json"])["item"] for e in led.events(county) if e["kind"] == "item_end"}
752	    for e in led.events(county):
753	        if e["kind"] == "suspect":
754	            cl.handled.add(tuple(json.loads(e["payload_json"])["entity"]))
755	    cl.ev("close_start", failing_before=before, reader=cl.reader, ladder=cl.ladder)
756	    cl.sync_status()                       # cells whose sums already hold are accepted; a resumed run keeps its own
757	    worked = 0
758	    complete = False
759	    try:
760	        with tracing.trace("close_county", kind="AGENT", run=run_id, county=county):
761	            tried: set = set()
762	            while True:
763	                chs = cl.checks_now()
764	                up = cl.given_up()
765	                vids = {v["sum_id"] for v in led.verdicts(county)}
766	                if max_items is not None and worked >= max_items:
767	                    break
768	                sus = next_suspects(cl, chs, vids, up) if pair else []
769	                if sus:
770	                    s = sus[0]
771	                    worked += 1
772	                    log(f"item {worked}: suspect {sum_id(s.sums[0])} / {sum_id(s.sums[1])}")
773	                    with tracing.trace("work_suspect", kind="TOOL", run=run_id, county=county, page=s.sums[0].page,
774	                                       block=s.sums[0].block_id):
775	                        cl.work_suspect(s)
776	                    continue
777	                todo = [i for i in work_list(chs, done_ids | vids, up) if i.id not in tried]
778	                if not todo:
779	                    complete = True
780	                    break
781	                item = todo[0]
782	                tried.add(item.id)
783	                worked += 1
784	                log(f"item {worked}: {item.id}")
785	                cl.work(item)
786	                done_ids.add(item.id)
787	            if complete:
788	                _finish(cl)
789	    except BudgetExceeded as e:
790	        stopped = str(e)
791	        log(f"stopped: {e}")
792	        cl.ev("stop", item=None, reason=stopped, cells=[])
793	    after = count_failing(cl.checks_now())
794	    cells = led.cells(county)
795	    totals_changed = sum(1 for t in led.totals(county)
796	                         if t["value"] != first_totals.get((t["page"], t["block_id"], t["direction"], t["key"])))
797	    vs = led.verdicts(county)
798	    s = {"county": county, "run_id": run_id, "reader": cl.reader, "ladder": cl.ladder, "items_worked": worked,
799	         "sums_failing_before": before, "sums_failing_after": after,
800	         "cells_reread": len({e for e in cl.reread_entities if e[0] == "cell"}),
801	         "values_reread": len(cl.reread_entities),
802	         "cells_changed": sum(1 for c in cells if c["value"] != first.get(_ckey(c))),
803	         "totals_changed": totals_changed,
804	         "cells_total": len(cells), "cells_accepted": sum(c["status"] == "accepted" for c in cells),
805	         "cells_cannot_verify": sum(c["status"] == "cannot_verify" for c in cells),
806	         "cells_document_inconsistent": sum(c["status"] == "document_inconsistent" for c in cells),
807	         "cells_open": sum(c["status"] not in ("accepted", "cannot_verify", "document_inconsistent") for c in cells),
808	         "verdicts": {k: sum(1 for v in vs if v["verdict"] == k) for k in ("document_inconsistent", "cannot_verify")},
809	         "model_calls": gw.calls - c0, "prompt_tokens": gw.prompt_tokens - p0[0],
810	         "completion_tokens": gw.completion_tokens - p0[1], "metered_cost_estimate": round(gw.cost - p0[2], 4),
811	         "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1), "stopped": stopped}
812	    cl.ev("close_end", summary=s)
813	    return s

816	def finalize_open(led, county, ev=None) -> list[dict]:
817	    """Every value ends accepted, document_inconsistent or cannot_verify. A cell still open after the loop sits on a
818	    failing sum (else it would be accepted); that sum has a verdict, and the cell takes the verdict's status and reason.
819	    Safe to run again. Returns the changes."""
820	    cells, totals = led.cells(county), led.totals(county)
821	    on = checks.crossing(cells, totals)
822	    vs = {v["sum_id"]: v for v in led.verdicts(county)}
823	    out = []
824	    for c in cells:
825	        if c["status"] in ("accepted", *FINAL):
826	            continue
827	        mine = [vs[sum_id(x)] for x in on.get(_ckey(c), []) if not x.ok and sum_id(x) in vs]
828	        if not mine:
829	            continue
830	        v = next((x for x in mine if x["verdict"] == "document_inconsistent"), mine[0])
831	        led.set_status(county, c["page"], c["block_id"], c["row_kind"], c["column"], v["verdict"], v["reason"])
832	        out.append({"cell": list(_ckey(c)), "old": c["status"], "new": v["verdict"], "reason": v["reason"]})
833	    if out and ev:
834	        ev("status_change", changes=out)
835	    return out

838	def _finish(cl: Closer):
839	    """After every failing sum has been worked: a cell on no printed sum becomes cannot_verify, and a sum that still
840	    fails without a verdict (it shares a value that was given up on) gets one. Cells on a failing sum that is explained
841	    by another value are left as they are, with the sum's verdict as the reason."""
842	    cells, totals = cl.led.cells(cl.county), cl.led.totals(cl.county)
843	    on = checks.crossing(cells, totals)
844	    for c in cells:
845	        if c["status"] == "accepted" or c["status"] in FINAL or on.get(_ckey(c)):
846	            continue
847	        reason = "no printed sum covers this cell"
848	        cl.led.set_status(cl.county, c["page"], c["block_id"], c["row_kind"], c["column"], "cannot_verify", reason)
849	        cl.ev("status_change", changes=[{"cell": list(_ckey(c)), "old": c["status"], "new": "cannot_verify",
850	                                         "reason": reason}])
851	    have = {v["sum_id"] for v in cl.led.verdicts(cl.county)}
852	    for ch in checks.all_checks(cells, totals):
853	        if not ch.ok and sum_id(ch) not in have:
854	            why = "a value on this sum was given up on, so the sum cannot be made to hold"
855	            cl.led.set_verdict(cl.county, sum_id(ch), ch.page, ch.block_id, "cannot_verify", why)
856	            cl.ev("verdict", sums=[sum_id(ch)], verdict="cannot_verify", reason=why, entity=None)

"""Command-line entry point."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys

from . import sources
from .render import RenderError, page_png


def _counties(args) -> list[str]:
    if getattr(args, "all", False):
        return list(sources.COUNTIES)
    return [args.county]


def cmd_fetch(args) -> int:
    rc = 0
    for key in _counties(args):
        try:
            got = sources.fetch(key)
            print(f"{key}: downloaded {', '.join(got)}" if got else f"{key}: cached, nothing downloaded")
        except sources.FetchError as e:
            print(f"{key}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
            rc = 1
    return rc


def cmd_filecheck(args) -> int:
    rc = 0
    for key in _counties(args):
        try:
            sources.fetch(key)
        except sources.FetchError as e:
            print(f"{key}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
            rc = 1
            continue
        bad, checked, skipped = sources.file_mismatches(sources.read_published(key))
        print(f"{key}: {len(bad)} row(s) differ, {checked} checked, {skipped} skipped (blank part)")
        for r in bad:
            print(f"  {r['precinct']} | {r['office']} | {r['candidate']}: votes={r['votes']} "
                  f"but absentee+early_voting+election_day={r['parts_sum']}")
    return rc


def cmd_render(args) -> int:
    try:
        sources.fetch(args.county)
        from PIL import Image
        out = page_png(args.county, args.page, args.dpi)
        with Image.open(out) as im:
            print(f"{out} {im.width}x{im.height} px")
    except (RenderError, sources.FetchError) as e:
        print(e, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return 0


def cmd_budget(args) -> int:
    from .model import gateway_spend
    try:
        spend, limit = gateway_spend()
    except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError) as e:
        print(f"cannot read the gateway's spend: {type(e).__name__} (is LITELLM_BASE_URL / LITELLM_API_KEY set?)",
              file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print(f"gateway spend so far: ${spend:.4f}; limit: " + (f"${limit:.2f}" if limit is not None else "none"))
    return 0


def cmd_read(args) -> int:
    import json
    import time
    from pathlib import Path

    from . import tracing
    from .ledger import Ledger
    from .layouts import matrix
    from .model import Gateway, gateway_spend
    note = tracing.init()
    if note:
        print(note)
    if args.county != "panola":
        print(f"{args.county}: only the matrix layout (panola) is built so far", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    try:
        sources.fetch(args.county)
    except sources.FetchError as e:
        print(e, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    try:
        before = gateway_spend()[0]
    except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError):
        before = None
    run_id = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    out = Path("runs") / run_id
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    led = Ledger(out / "ledger.sqlite")
    gw = Gateway(budget=args.budget)
    pages = [int(x) for x in args.pages.split(",")] if args.pages else None
    print(f"run {run_id}: reading {args.county} ({'reader chosen by a sample' if args.model == 'auto' else args.model}), "
          f"run budget ${args.budget:.2f}")
    try:
        s = matrix.read_county(args.county, gw, led, run_id=run_id, pages=pages, model=args.model)
    except (RenderError, RuntimeError) as e:
        print(e, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        tracing.shutdown()
    try:
        s["gateway_spend_before"], s["gateway_spend_after"] = before, gateway_spend()[0]
        s["gateway_spend_change"] = round(s["gateway_spend_after"] - before, 4)
    except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
        pass
    s["ledger"] = str(out / "ledger.sqlite")
    (out / "first-read.json").write_text(json.dumps(s, indent=2))
    print(f"blocks found: {s['blocks_found']} (failed {s['blocks_failed']})")
    print(f"cells read: {s['cells_read']} (failed {s['failed_cells']})")
    print(f"reader: {s['reader']}" + (f" (sample {s['sample']['failing']} of {s['sample']['row_sums']} row sums failing)"
                                      if s.get("sample") and not s["sample"].get("skipped") else ""))
    print(f"row sums: {s['row_sums_pass']} pass, {s['row_sums_fail']} fail")
    print(f"column sums: {s['col_sums_pass']} pass, {s['col_sums_fail']} fail")
    print(f"grand totals: {s['grand_sums_pass']} pass, {s['grand_sums_fail']} fail")
    print(f"model calls: {s['model_calls']}; tokens: {s['prompt_tokens']} in, {s['completion_tokens']} out; "
          f"metered cost (estimate): ${s['metered_cost_estimate']:.4f}; seconds: {s['seconds']}")
    if "gateway_spend_change" in s:
        print(f"gateway spend: ${s['gateway_spend_before']:.4f} -> ${s['gateway_spend_after']:.4f} "
              f"(change ${s['gateway_spend_change']:.4f})")
    print(f"written: {out / 'first-read.json'}")
    return 2 if s["stopped"] else 0


def cmd_close(args) -> int:
    import json
    import shutil
    import time
    from pathlib import Path

    from . import agent, outputs, tracing
    from .layouts import matrix
    from .ledger import Ledger
    from .model import Gateway, gateway_spend
    if args.county != "panola":
        print(f"{args.county}: only the matrix layout (panola) is built so far", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    resume = args.resume
    if resume == "latest":
        reads = sorted(p.parent.name for p in Path("runs").glob("*/first-read.json"))
        if not reads:
            print("no run with a first-read.json to resume from", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        resume = reads[-1]
    src = Path("runs") / resume / "ledger.sqlite"
    if not src.exists():
        print(f"{src} does not exist", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    note = tracing.init()
    if note:
        print(note)
    try:
        before = gateway_spend()[0]
    except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError):
        before = None
    started = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
    run_id = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    out = Path("runs") / run_id
    out.mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copy(src, out / "ledger.sqlite")      # the run resumed from is never changed
    led = Ledger(out / "ledger.sqlite")
    cols = matrix.precinct_order(led, args.county)
    if not cols:
        print("the ledger has no header block (registered voters row); nothing to place columns by", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    geo = matrix.Geometry(args.county, cols)
    chosen = next((json.loads(e["payload_json"]).get("reader") for e in reversed(led.events(args.county))
                   if e["kind"] == "choose_reader"), None)
    reader = chosen or "claude-haiku"
    gw = Gateway(budget=args.budget, model=reader)
    print(f"run {run_id}: closing {args.county} from {resume} (reader {reader}"
          f"{'' if chosen else ', not recorded in the ledger: the cheapest is assumed'}), run budget ${args.budget:.2f}")
    try:
        s = agent.close_county(args.county, gw, led, geo, run_id=run_id, max_items=args.max_items, reader=reader)
    except RenderError as e:
        print(e, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        tracing.shutdown()
    try:
        s["gateway_spend_before"], s["gateway_spend_after"] = before, gateway_spend()[0]
        s["gateway_spend_change"] = round(s["gateway_spend_after"] - before, 4)
    except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
        pass
    outputs.write_county(out, args.county, run_id, led, geo, s)
    outputs.write_run(out, run_id, started=started, ended=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"),
                      command="crossfoot " + " ".join(sys.argv[1:]), counties=[args.county], gw=gw,
                      resumed_from=resume)
    b, a = s["sums_failing_before"], s["sums_failing_after"]
    print(f"sums failing before: {b['row']} row, {b['col']} column, {b['grand']} grand (small totals), "
          f"{b['grand_row']} grand (row totals)")
    print(f"sums failing after:  {a['row']} row, {a['col']} column, {a['grand']} grand (small totals), "
          f"{a['grand_row']} grand (row totals)")
    print(f"values re-read: {s['values_reread']}; cells changed: {s['cells_changed']}, totals changed: "
          f"{s['totals_changed']}; cannot_verify: {s['cells_cannot_verify']}; document_inconsistent: "
          f"{s['cells_document_inconsistent']}; accepted: {s['cells_accepted']} of {s['cells_total']}; "
          f"still open: {s['cells_open']}")
    print(f"verdicts on sums still failing: {s['verdicts']['document_inconsistent']} document_inconsistent, "
          f"{s['verdicts']['cannot_verify']} cannot_verify")
    print(f"model calls: {s['model_calls']}; tokens: {s['prompt_tokens']} in, {s['completion_tokens']} out; "
          f"metered cost (estimate): ${s['metered_cost_estimate']:.4f}; seconds: {s['seconds']}")
    if "gateway_spend_change" in s:
        print(f"gateway spend: ${s['gateway_spend_before']:.4f} -> ${s['gateway_spend_after']:.4f} "
              f"(change ${s['gateway_spend_change']:.4f})")
    print(f"written: {out / args.county / 'county.json'}, {out / 'run.json'}")
    return 2 if s["stopped"] else 0


def _latest_closed_run() -> str | None:
    from pathlib import Path
    runs = sorted(p.parent.parent.name for p in Path("runs").glob("*/*/county.json") if (p.parent.parent / "ledger.sqlite").exists())
    return runs[-1] if runs else None


def cmd_audit(args) -> int:
    import json
    import shutil
    import time
    from pathlib import Path

    from . import agent, audit, outputs, policy, tracing
    from .layouts import matrix
    from .ledger import Ledger
    from .model import BudgetExceeded, gateway_spend
    from .render import RenderError
    if args.county != "panola":
        print(f"{args.county}: only the matrix layout (panola) is built so far", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

def cmd_verify_known(args) -> int:
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    known = Path("tests") / f"known_{args.county}.json"
    runs = sorted(p for p in Path("runs").glob(f"*/{args.county}/findings.json"))
    if not known.exists() or not runs:
        print(f"need {known} and a run with {args.county}/findings.json", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    want = json.loads(known.read_text())["expected"]
    d = json.loads(runs[-1].read_text())
    fs = d["findings"]
    missing = []
    for e in want:
        hit = [f for f in fs if (not e.get("kind") or f["kind"] == e["kind"]) and
               e.get("office_contains", "").lower() in f["office"].lower() and
               e.get("candidate_contains", "").lower() in f["candidate"].lower() and
               (not e.get("precinct") or f["precinct"] == e["precinct"])]
        if not hit:
            missing.append(e)
    found = len(want) - len(missing)
    print(f"findings file: {runs[-1]}")
    print(f"expected {len(want)}, found {found}, findings in all {len(fs)}")
    for e in missing:
        print(f"  missing: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    return 1 if missing else 0


def cmd_policy(args) -> int:
    from . import policy
    if args.action == "set":
        if args.answer not in policy.ANSWERS:
            print(f"--answer must be one of {', '.join(policy.ANSWERS)}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        d = policy.set_answer(args.answer)
        print(f"stored: {d['question_id']} = {d['answer']} ({policy.TEXT[d['answer']]}); answered by {d['answered_by']}")
        return 0
    d = policy.current()
    print(f"{d['question_id']} = {d['answer']} ({policy.TEXT[d['answer']]}); answered by {d['answered_by']}")
    return 0


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="crossfoot")
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    for name, fn, h in (("fetch", cmd_fetch, "download a county's scan and published file"),
                        ("filecheck", cmd_filecheck, "list published rows whose votes differ from their parts")):
        s = sub.add_parser(name, help=h)
        g = s.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
        g.add_argument("--county", choices=list(sources.COUNTIES))
        g.add_argument("--all", action="store_true")
        s.set_defaults(fn=fn)
    s = sub.add_parser("render", help="render one scan page to PNG")
    s.add_argument("--county", required=True, choices=list(sources.COUNTIES))
    s.add_argument("--page", type=int, required=True)
    s.add_argument("--dpi", type=int, default=200)
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_render)
    s = sub.add_parser("read", help="first read of a county's scan into a new run's ledger")
    s.add_argument("--county", required=True, choices=list(sources.COUNTIES))
    s.add_argument("--budget", type=float, default=2.00, help="dollars this run may meter (default 2.00)")
    s.add_argument("--pages", help="comma-separated pages, default all (the sample of --model auto always reads page 1)")
    s.add_argument("--model", default="auto", help="auto (default): read a sample of page 1 with claude-haiku and choose "
                   "the reader by how many of its row sums fail; or a model name, which skips the sample")
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_read)
    s = sub.add_parser("close", help="work every failing sum of a first-read ledger until each cell is accepted or "
                                     "cannot_verify")
    s.add_argument("--county", required=True, choices=list(sources.COUNTIES))
    s.add_argument("--resume", required=True, help="run id whose ledger is copied into a new run, or 'latest' for the "
                   "newest read (a run with a first-read.json)")
    s.add_argument("--budget", type=float, default=1.50, help="dollars this run may meter (default 1.50)")
    s.add_argument("--max-items", type=int, help="work at most this many failing sums (for trials)")
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_close)
    s = sub.add_parser("audit", help="read (or reuse a ledger), close it, compare it with the published file, write "
                                     "findings, a corrected file, a diff and a report")
    s.add_argument("--county", required=True, choices=list(sources.COUNTIES))
    s.add_argument("--resume", help="run id whose ledger is reused instead of reading again, or 'latest' for the "
                   "newest run with a county.json")
    s.add_argument("--budget", type=float, default=2.00, help="dollars this run may meter (default 2.00)")
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_audit)
    s = sub.add_parser("verify-known", help="check the newest findings.json against the answer key in tests/")
    s.add_argument("--county", required=True, choices=list(sources.COUNTIES))
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_verify_known)
    s = sub.add_parser("policy", help="the one question the audit asks a person")
    s.add_argument("action", choices=["set", "show"])
    s.add_argument("--answer", help="cells or totals (with `set`)")
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_policy)
    s = sub.add_parser("budget", help="print the gateway's spend and limit for the key")
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_budget)
    args = p.parse_args(argv)
    return args.fn(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

1	"""The audit: compare a closed ledger with the published file, settle each disagreement with the scan's printed totals.
2	
3	The published file is a second reading of the same scan. It tells the audit where to look, never what to write: a
4	value changes only because a re-read of the scan gave it, and a correction to the file is written only where a printed
5	total decides it.
6	
7	Steps: (1) match the scan's contests and candidates to the file's, by normalised labels first, then once per county
8	by the model as two lists (checked in code: one-to-one, close county totals); what is left is listed. (2) Compare every
9	part of every row. (3) Look at each disagreeing value on the scan once more (400 dpi, claude-sonnet-4.6, up to three at
10	a time); if it gives the file's value and the sums hold with it, the ledger was wrong, it is corrected, and there is no
11	finding. (4) Classify what is left, group the findings that describe one slip, and decide each one's status from the
12	sums it sits on. (5) Write the corrected file, which differs from the published one only where a finding is
13	`settled_against_file`.

15	findings.json
16	  county, run_id, file         names; file = the published file's name

244	                 "\nSCAN CANDIDATES:\n" + "\n".join(f"{i}: {b.contest} :: {b.candidate}" for i, b in enumerate(s_can)) +
245	                 "\nFILE CANDIDATES:\n" + "\n".join(
246	                     f"{j}: {fcs[fk].label}{' district ' + fcs[fk].district if fcs[fk].district else ''} :: "
247	                     f"{fcs[fk].cands[ck].label}" for j, (fk, ck) in enumerate(f_can)))
248	        ns = {"contests": (len(s_con), len(f_con)), "candidates": (len(s_can), len(f_can))}
249	        try:
250	            ans = gw.ask_json(MATCH_PROMPT.format(lists=lists), validate=match_validator(ns), model=agent.SONNET)
251	        except BudgetExceeded:
252	            raise
253	        except ValueError as e:
254	            ans = {"contests": [], "candidates": []}
255	            m.rejected.append({"what": "the model's answer", "why": f"not usable: {str(e)[:150]}"})
256	        m.model = {"asked": {"scan_contests": s_con, "file_contests": [c.label for c in f_con],
257	                             "scan_candidates": [f"{b.contest} :: {b.candidate}" for b in s_can],
258	                             "file_candidates": [f"{fcs[fk].label} :: {fcs[fk].cands[ck].label}" for fk, ck in f_can]},
259	                   "answer": ans}
260	        # contests: one-to-one, and the blocks of the scan contest add up close to the file's rows
261	        seen_s, seen_f = set(), set()
262	        for i, j in ans.get("contests", []):
263	            if not (0 <= i < len(s_con) and 0 <= j < len(f_con)) or i in seen_s or j in seen_f:
264	                m.rejected.append({"what": f"contest pair {i}/{j}", "why": "not one-to-one, or not in the list"})
265	                continue
266	            seen_s.add(i); seen_f.add(j)
267	            sa = sum(b.total() or 0 for b in blocks if b.contest == s_con[i])
268	            fb = sum(file_votes(c) for c in f_con[j].cands.values())
269	            if not _close(sa, fb):
270	                m.rejected.append({"what": f"{s_con[i]} = {f_con[j].label}",
271	                                   "why": f"county totals are not close (scan {sa}, file {fb})"})
272	                continue
273	            cmap[s_con[i]] = f_con[j].key
274	        by_names(blocks, cmap)
275	        sc, fc = leftovers()
276	        fset = set(fc)
277	        seen_s, seen_f = set(), set()
278	        for i, j in ans.get("candidates", []):
279	            if not (0 <= i < len(s_can) and 0 <= j < len(f_can)) or i in seen_s or j in seen_f:
280	                m.rejected.append({"what": f"candidate pair {i}/{j}", "why": "not one-to-one, or not in the list"})
281	                continue
282	            seen_s.add(i); seen_f.add(j)
283	            b, (fk, ck) = s_can[i], f_can[j]
284	            if b.id in m.block_map or (fk, ck) not in fset:
285	                continue                                  # already matched by name inside a mapped contest
286	            if cmap.get(b.contest) != fk:
287	                m.rejected.append({"what": f"{b.candidate} = {fcs[fk].cands[ck].label}",
288	                                   "why": "their contests are not paired"})
289	                continue
290	            if not _close(b.total(), file_votes(fcs[fk].cands[ck])):
291	                m.rejected.append({"what": f"{b.candidate} = {fcs[fk].cands[ck].label}",
292	                                   "why": f"county totals are not close (scan {b.total()}, "
293	                                          f"file {file_votes(fcs[fk].cands[ck])})"})
294	                continue
295	            m.block_map[b.id] = (fk, ck)
296	    sc, fc = leftovers()
297	    m.unmatched_scan = [{"block": b.id, "page": b.page, "contest": b.contest, "candidate": b.candidate} for b in sc]
298	    m.unmatched_file = [{"contest": fcs[fk].label, "district": fcs[fk].district, "candidate": fcs[fk].cands[ck].label,
299	                         "rows": len(fcs[fk].cands[ck].rows)} for fk, ck in fc]
300	    return m

338	def build_rows(blocks, matching, fcs, file_rows) -> list[Row]:
339	    out, seen = [], set()

342	            continue

355	                           fc.label, fc.district, (r.get("party") if fr else "") or "", cand.label))
356	    for i, r in enumerate(file_rows):      # file rows with no scan block: only their own sum can be tested

378	def decide_status(sums: list[dict], doubt: str | None = None) -> tuple[str, str]:
379	    """The status of a disagreement from the printed sums it sits on. Each sum: {name, holds_with_scan, holds_with_file}.
380	
381	    settled_against_file: at least one printed total holds with the scan's value and fails with the file's, and none holds
382	      with the file's and fails with the scan's, and the scan's totals do not disagree with each other at the cell.
383	    document_inconsistent: the scan's own printed totals disagree with each other at the cell: some hold with the
384	      scan's value and some do not (the reason names which).
385	    cannot_verify: no printed total decides (a sum that fails with both values decides nothing), or the scan's value
386	      is itself in doubt."""
387	    if doubt:
388	        return "cannot_verify", doubt
389	    for_scan = [s for s in sums if s["holds_with_scan"] and not s["holds_with_file"]]
390	    for_file = [s for s in sums if not s["holds_with_scan"] and s["holds_with_file"]]
391	    both_fail = [s for s in sums if not s["holds_with_scan"] and not s["holds_with_file"]]
392	    if for_scan and for_file:
393	        return ("document_inconsistent",
394	                "the scan's own printed totals disagree with each other at this cell: " +
395	                "; ".join(s["name"] for s in for_scan) + " hold(s) with the scan's value and fail(s) with the file's, but " +
396	                "; ".join(s["name"] for s in for_file) + " hold(s) with the file's value and fail(s) with the scan's")
397	    if for_scan:
398	        note = (" (" + "; ".join(s["name"] for s in both_fail) + " fail with either value and decide nothing)"
399	                if both_fail else "")
400	        return ("settled_against_file",
401	                "; ".join(s["name"] for s in for_scan) + " hold(s) with the scan's value and fail(s) with the file's, "
402	                "and no printed total holds with the file's value and fails with the scan's" + note)
403	    if for_file:
404	        return ("cannot_verify",
405	                "the scan's value is in doubt: " + "; ".join(s["name"] for s in for_file) +
406	                " holds with the file's value and fails with the scan's, and no printed total supports the scan's")
407	    return "cannot_verify", ("no printed total decides: " + ("; ".join(s["name"] for s in sums) +
408	                                                              " give the same answer with either value"
409	                                                              if sums else "no printed total covers this value"))
410	
411	
412	def sums_decide(sums: list[dict]) -> bool:
413	    """True when every printed sum through a value holds with the ledger's value and fails with the file's (two sums
414	    for a cell or a printed total, one for a value that sits on one sum). No single-value look at the scan outweighs it."""
415	    return bool(sums) and all(s["holds_with_scan"] and not s["holds_with_file"] for s in sums)
416	
417	
418	def finding_status(sums: list[dict], rd: dict | None, sv, fv) -> tuple[str, str, bool]:
419	    """(status, reason, reread_disagrees). The printed sums decide; the single-value re-read is only a note.
420	    settled_against_file   every sum through the value holds with the ledger's value and fails with the file's
421	    document_inconsistent  some sums hold with the ledger's value and fail with the file's, others the other way round
422	    cannot_verify          anything else (a sum that fails with both values, or holds with both, decides nothing)
423	    reread_disagrees is true when a re-read was made, gave a number, and it differs from the ledger's value."""
424	    got = rd.get("value") if rd else None
425	    disagrees = got is not None and got != sv
426	    note = f" (a single-value re-read of the scan gave {got}; the printed sums decide regardless)" if disagrees else ""
427	    if sums_decide(sums):
428	        return "settled_against_file", decide_status(sums)[1] + note, disagrees
429	    st, why = decide_status(sums)
430	    if st == "settled_against_file":                  # some sum fails with both values or holds with both: no decision
431	        und = [x["name"] for x in sums if not (x["holds_with_scan"] and not x["holds_with_file"])]
432	        why = ("the sums do not decide: " + "; ".join(und) + " fail(s) with either value or hold(s) with both, "
433	               "although others hold with the scan's value and fail with the file's")
434	        st = "cannot_verify"
435	    if st == "cannot_verify" and rd is not None and rd.get("value") is None and rd.get("error"):
436	        why += f"; the re-read of the scan could not be made ({rd['error']})"
437	    return st, why + (note if st == "cannot_verify" else ""), disagrees

467	def _variant(cells, totals, ent, value):
468	    cs, ts = [dict(c) for c in cells], [dict(t) for t in totals]
469	    if ent[0] == "cell":
470	        key = tuple(ent[1:])
471	        hit = [c for c in cs if checks.cell_key(c) == key]
472	        for c in hit:
473	            c["value"] = value
474	        if not hit and value is not None:
475	            cs.append({"page": ent[1], "block_id": ent[2], "row_kind": ent[3], "column": ent[4], "value": value})
476	    else:
477	        key = tuple(ent[1:])
478	        hit = [t for t in ts if (t["page"], t["block_id"], t["direction"], t["key"]) == key]
479	        for t in hit:
480	            t["value"] = value
481	        if not hit and value is not None:
482	            ts.append({"page": ent[1], "block_id": ent[2], "direction": ent[3], "key": ent[4], "value": value})
483	    return checks.all_checks(cs, ts)

497	def sums_for(ent, scan_value, file_value, cells, totals) -> list[dict]:
498	    """The printed sums the scan value sits on, each tested with the scan's value and with the file's (a value the file
499	    lacks counts as 0; one the scan lacks counts as absent). `cells`/`totals` are the ledger's rows of the one block."""
500	    with_scan = {_ck(c): c for c in _variant(cells, totals, ent, scan_value)}
501	    with_file = {_ck(c): c for c in _variant(cells, totals, ent, 0 if file_value is None else file_value)}
502	    out = []
503	    for k, fch in with_file.items():
504	        sch = with_scan.get(k)
505	        if sch is None or not (_touches(fch, ent) or _touches(sch, ent)):
506	            continue
507	        name, label = describe_sum(sch)
508	        out.append({"name": name, "kind": sch.kind, "page": sch.page, "block": sch.block_id,
509	                    "terms": [{"cell": list(kk), "value": v} for kk, v in sch.terms], "printed": sch.printed,
510	                    "printed_label": label, "computed_with_scan": sch.computed, "holds_with_scan": sch.ok,
511	                    "computed_with_file": fch.computed, "holds_with_file": fch.ok})
512	    order = {"row": 0, "col": 1, "grand_col": 2, "grand_row": 3}
513	    out.sort(key=lambda s: order[s["kind"]])
514	    return out

519	@dataclass
520	class Slot:
521	    row: Row
522	    part: str
523	    kind: str
524	    group: tuple

526	
527	def _tuple(d):
528	    return tuple(d[p] for p in PARTS) if d and all(d[p] is not None for p in PARTS) else None
529	
530	
531	def classify(rows: list[Row]) -> list[Slot]:
532	    """Every disagreement as a slot with a kind and a group key. A group is one slip:
533	    wrong_precinct  the same row of values sits under another precinct of the same candidate (unique matches only)
534	    wrong_column    the same values sit in other parts of the same precinct
535	    wrong_number    anything else that differs
536	    missing_row / extra_row    the scan has a row the file lacks, or the other way round
537	    file_row_fails_own_total   the file's votes differ from its three parts (whether or not the scan differs)"""
538	    slots: list[Slot] = []
539	    by_block: dict = {}
540	    for r in rows:
541	        by_block.setdefault(r.block.id if r.block else None, []).append(r)
542	    for bid, rs in by_block.items():
543	        if bid is None:
544	            continue
545	        d = [r for r in rs if (r.file is None) != (r.scan is None) or diff_parts(r)]
546	        tf = {id(r): _tuple(r.file) for r in d}
547	        ts = {id(r): _tuple(r.scan) for r in d}
548	        parent = {id(r): id(r) for r in d}
549	
550	        def find(x):
551	            while parent[x] != x:
552	                parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
553	                x = parent[x]
554	            return x
555	        linked, edge = set(), {}
556	        for p in d:
557	            v = tf[id(p)]
558	            if v is None or not any(v):
559	                continue
560	            src = [x for x in d if tf[id(x)] == v]
561	            dst = [x for x in d if ts[id(x)] == v and x is not p]
562	            if len(src) == 1 and len(dst) == 1:
563	                edge[id(p)] = dst[0]
564	        for pid, q in edge.items():
565	            p = next(x for x in d if id(x) == pid)
566	            swap = tf[id(q)] is not None and tf[id(q)] == ts[id(p)]
567	            if swap or tf[pid][0] >= MIN_LINK_VOTES:
568	                parent[find(pid)] = find(id(q))
569	                linked.update((pid, id(q)))
570	        comps: dict = {}
571	        for r in d:
572	            if id(r) in linked:
573	                comps.setdefault(find(id(r)), []).append(r)
574	        for ci, members in enumerate(comps.values()):
575	            key = ("wrong_precinct", bid, ci)
576	            for r in members:
577	                if r.file and r.scan:
578	                    slots += [Slot(r, p, "wrong_precinct", key) for p in diff_parts(r)]
579	                else:
580	                    slots.append(Slot(r, "votes", "wrong_precinct", key))
581	        for r in d:
582	            if id(r) in linked:
583	                continue
584	            key = (None, bid, r.precinct)
585	            if r.file is None:
586	                slots.append(Slot(r, "votes", "missing_row", ("missing_row", *key[1:])))
587	            elif r.scan is None:
588	                slots.append(Slot(r, "votes", "extra_row", ("extra_row", *key[1:])))
589	            else:
590	                dp = diff_parts(r)
591	                cols = [p for p in dp if p != "votes"]
592	                if (len(cols) >= 2 and "votes" not in dp and
593	                        sorted(r.file[p] for p in cols) == sorted(r.scan[p] for p in cols)):
594	                    slots += [Slot(r, p, "wrong_column", ("wrong_column", *key[1:])) for p in cols]
595	                else:
596	                    slots += [Slot(r, p, "wrong_number", ("wrong_number", *key[1:])) for p in dp]
597	    for r in rows:                                    # the file's own sum, whatever the scan says
598	        if row_fails_own_total(r):
599	            slots = [s for s in slots if not (s.row is r and s.part == "votes")]
600	            slots.append(Slot(r, "votes", "file_row_fails_own_total",
601	                              ("file_row_fails_own_total", r.block.id if r.block else None, r.precinct, r.file_idx)))
602	    return slots

617	def reread_slots(slots, geo, gw, crop_dir: Path, *, log=print, only=None) -> dict:
618	    """Look at each disagreeing value on the scan once more: 400 dpi crop, claude-sonnet-4.6, up to three at a time.
619	    Only the entities in `only` are read (the values the printed sums do not decide). Returns
620	    {entity: {value, model, dpi, crop, error}}."""
621	    todo: dict = {}
622	    for s in slots:
623	        if s.row.file and s.row.scan and s.part in diff_parts(s.row):
624	            ent = entity_key(s.row, s.part)
625	            if ent is not None and (only is None or ent in only):
626	                todo.setdefault(ent, None)
627	    jobs, out = [], {}
628	    for n, ent in enumerate(todo, 1):
629	        t = target_for(ent)
630	        try:
631	            path, _ = geo.crop(ent[1], ent[2], t, REREAD_DPI, crop_dir / f"audit-reread-{n:04d}-{ent[2]}.png")
632	        except Exception as e:                        # no crop for it: the re-read cannot be made
633	            out[ent] = {"value": None, "model": REREAD_MODEL, "dpi": REREAD_DPI, "crop": None,
634	                        "error": f"no crop: {str(e)[:120]}"}
635	            continue
636	        jobs.append((ent, t, path))
637	    stop = threading.Event()
638	
639	    def run(job):
640	        ent, t, path = job
641	        if stop.is_set():
642	            return ent, {"value": None, "model": REREAD_MODEL, "dpi": REREAD_DPI, "crop": str(path),
643	                         "error": "not made: the run's budget was reached"}
644	        try:
645	            v = _reread_one(gw, path, t, REREAD_MODEL)
646	            return ent, {"value": v, "model": REREAD_MODEL, "dpi": REREAD_DPI, "crop": str(path), "error": None}
647	        except BudgetExceeded as e:
648	            stop.set()
649	            return ent, {"value": None, "model": REREAD_MODEL, "dpi": REREAD_DPI, "crop": str(path), "error": str(e)[:120]}
650	        except Exception as e:
651	            return ent, {"value": None, "model": REREAD_MODEL, "dpi": REREAD_DPI, "crop": str(path),
652	                         "error": f"no usable answer: {str(e)[:120]}"}
653	    with ThreadPoolExecutor(PARALLEL) as ex:
654	        for ent, res in ex.map(run, jobs):
655	            out[ent] = res
656	    log(f"  re-read {len(jobs)} values on the scan")
657	    return out

676	    """Run the audit on a closed ledger. Re-reads go through `gw`; the ledger is changed only where a re-read gave the
677	    file's value and every sum holds with it. Returns the findings, groups, corrections and what could not be matched."""
678	    t0 = time.time()
679	    run_dir = Path(run_dir)
680	    crop_dir = run_dir / county / "crops"              # one picture per group
681	    reread_dir = run_dir / "crops"                     # the re-read crops, not committed
682	    cells, totals, blocks, fcs = _state(led, county, file_rows, gw, log)
683	    matching = match(blocks, fcs, gw, log)
684	    rows = build_rows(blocks, matching, fcs, file_rows)
685	    slots = classify(rows)
686	    n0 = len(slots)

688	    decided: dict = {}                               # entity -> do the printed sums decide it (then no re-read is made)
689	    for sl in slots:
690	        if sl.row.file and sl.row.scan and sl.part in diff_parts(sl.row):
691	            ent = entity_key(sl.row, sl.part)
692	            if ent is not None and ent not in decided:

695	    need = {e for e, d in decided.items() if not d}

698	    corrected_events, agreed_ledger = [], 0
699	    where = {entity_key(s.row, s.part): (s.row, s.part) for s in slots}
700	    for ent, rd in reads.items():
701	        if rd["value"] is None:
702	            continue
703	        row, part = where[ent]
704	        fv, old = row.file[part], row.scan[part]
705	        if rd["value"] == old:
706	            agreed_ledger += 1
707	        elif rd["value"] == fv:
708	            cs, ts = _block_rows(cells, totals, ent[1], ent[2])
709	            sums = sums_for(ent, old, fv, cs, ts)
710	            if sums and all(x["holds_with_file"] for x in sums):
711	                if ent[0] == "cell":
712	                    led.set_value(county, ent[1], ent[2], ent[3], ent[4], fv, REREAD_MODEL)
713	                    led.set_status(county, ent[1], ent[2], ent[3], ent[4], "first_read")
714	                else:
715	                    led.put_total(county, ent[1], ent[2], ent[3], ent[4], fv)
716	                led.event(county, "audit_ledger_corrected", {"entity": list(ent), "old": old, "new": fv,
717	                                                             "model": REREAD_MODEL, "dpi": REREAD_DPI, "sums": sums})
718	                corrected_events.append({"entity": list(ent), "old": old, "new": fv, "sums": sums})
719	                cells, totals = led.cells(county), led.totals(county)
720	    if corrected_events:
721	        agent.derive_status(led, county)
722	        cells, totals, blocks, fcs = _state(led, county, file_rows, gw, log)
723	        rows = build_rows(blocks, matching, fcs, file_rows)
724	        slots = classify(rows)
725	    findings, groups = _findings(county, slots, reads, cells, totals, geo, file_rows)
726	    res = {"findings": findings, "groups": groups, "matching": matching, "rows": len(rows), "crop_dir": crop_dir,
727	           "row_objs": rows, "cells": cells, "totals": totals,
728	           "corrected_events": corrected_events, "reads": reads,
729	           "audit": {"disagreements_found": n0, "rereads": len(reads),
730	                     "rereads_skipped_sums_decide": len(decided) - len(need), "rereads_agreed_with_ledger": agreed_ledger,
731	                     "rereads_agreed_with_file": sum(1 for r in reads.values() if r["value"] is not None) - agreed_ledger -
732	                     sum(1 for ent, r in reads.items() if r["value"] is not None and r["value"] != where[ent][0].file[where[ent][1]]
733	                         and r["value"] != where[ent][0].scan[where[ent][1]]),
734	                     "ledger_corrected": len(corrected_events), "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1)}}
735	    res["file_name"] = file_name

803	def what_to_do(group, slots) -> str:
804	    """One sentence for a wrong_precinct group: what a person would have to do to the file's rows."""
805	    rows = list({id(s.row): s.row for s in slots if s.group == group}.values())
806	    pairs = {}
807	    for p in rows:
808	        v = _tuple(p.file)

811	        dst = [q for q in rows if q is not p and _tuple(q.scan) == v]
812	        if len(dst) == 1:
813	            pairs[p.precinct] = dst[0].precinct
814	    cols = list(rows[0].block.cols) if rows and rows[0].block else []
815	    off = {cols.index(q) - cols.index(p) for p, q in pairs.items() if p in cols and q in cols}
816	    rest = len(rows) - len(pairs)
817	    tail = f", and {rest} more row(s) of the group have no counterpart (see the missing and extra rows)" if rest > 0 else ""
818	    n = len(pairs)

820	        k = abs(next(iter(off)))
821	        way = "later" if next(iter(off)) < 0 else "earlier"
822	        return (f"Move the same {n} rows of values, each labelled {k} precinct{'s' if k != 1 else ''} {way} than where "
823	                f"the scan has it, back to the precinct the scan puts them under{tail}.")
824	    shown = ", ".join(f"{p} to {q}" for p, q in list(pairs.items())[:8]) + (" and more" if n > 8 else "")

834	def _spans(line: str) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
835	    """Character spans of the fields of one csv line (quotes respected), without the line ending."""
836	    spans, start, i, q = [], 0, 0, False
837	    body = line.rstrip("\r\n")
838	    while i < len(body):
839	        ch = body[i]
840	        if ch == '"':
841	            q = not q
842	        elif ch == "," and not q:
843	            spans.append((start, i))
844	            start = i + 1
845	        i += 1

855	def whole_rows(raw: bytes, findings: list[dict]) -> tuple[list[dict], list[dict]]:
856	    """Keep a row's corrections only if the row is consistent afterwards: its corrected `votes` equals its corrected
857	    parts. Returns (findings that may be applied, rows that could not be corrected as a whole, each with its reason).
858	    Findings that would not be applied anyway pass through unchanged."""
859	    lines = raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines(True)

864	            by_row.setdefault(f["file_row"], []).append(f)
865	    bad, could = set(), []
866	    for i, fs in sorted(by_row.items()):
867	        cells = next(csv.reader(io.StringIO(lines[i + 1])))
868	        d = {h: (cells[k] if k < len(cells) else "") for k, h in enumerate(header)}
869	        val = {p: _int(d.get(p)) for p in PARTS}
870	        for f in fs:
871	            val[f["part"]] = f["scan_value"]
872	        parts = [val["absentee"], val["early_voting"], val["election_day"]]
873	        if val["votes"] is None or any(v is None for v in parts):
874	            why = "a number of the row is empty in the file, so the corrected row's total cannot be checked"
875	        elif val["votes"] != sum(parts):
876	            why = (f"the corrected votes {val['votes']} would not equal the corrected parts {parts[0]} + {parts[1]} + "
877	                   f"{parts[2]} = {sum(parts)}")
878	        else:
879	            continue
880	        bad.add(i)
881	        could.append({"file_row": i, "file_line": i + 2, "office": d.get("office"), "candidate": d.get("candidate"),
882	                      "precinct": d.get("precinct"), "findings": [f.get("id") for f in fs], "reason": why})
883	    return [f for f in findings if f.get("file_row") not in bad or not _correctable(f, header)], could

886	def apply_corrections(raw: bytes, findings: list[dict]) -> tuple[bytes, str, list[dict]]:
887	    """Change only the cells whose finding is settled_against_file (and whose scan value is a number and whose file row
888	    exists); keep every other byte. Returns (new bytes, unified diff of exactly the changed lines, what was applied).
889	    Each finding needs {file_row, part, file_value, scan_value, kind, status}; file_row is the index among the data rows."""
890	    text = raw.decode("utf-8")
891	    lines = text.splitlines(True)
892	    header = next(csv.reader(io.StringIO(lines[0])))
893	    new, applied = list(lines), []
894	    for f in findings:
895	        if not _correctable(f, header):
896	            continue
897	        i = f["file_row"] + 1
898	        if i >= len(new):
899	            continue
900	        sp = _spans(new[i])
901	        a, b = sp[header.index(f["part"])]
902	        new[i] = new[i][:a] + str(f["scan_value"]) + new[i][b:]
903	        applied.append({"finding": f.get("id"), "file_row": f["file_row"], "part": f["part"],
904	                        "old": f.get("file_value"), "new": f["scan_value"]})
905	    out = "".join(new)
906	    name = "published file"
907	    diff = "".join(difflib.unified_diff(lines, new, fromfile=f"a/{name}", tofile=f"b/{name}", n=0))
908	    return out.encode("utf-8"), diff, applied

925	def sums_check(cells, totals, rows, findings, applied, matching) -> dict:
926	    """Every printed sum of the county, tested three ways: with the ledger (the scan), with the published file's values in
927	    place of the ledger's, and with the corrected file's. Only matched rows (file row and scan row both there) take the
928	    file's values. Returns {in_all, holding_with_ledger, holding_with_published, holding_with_corrected, still_failing,
929	    rows_failing_own_total}; each still failing sum has its reasons."""
930	    new = {(a["file_row"], a["part"]): a["new"] for a in applied}
931	    pub, cor = {}, {}
932	    own = {"published": 0, "corrected": 0}
933	    for r in rows:
934	        if r.file is None:
935	            continue
936	        own["published"] += row_fails_own_total(r)
937	        parts = {p: new.get((r.file_idx, p), r.file[p]) for p in PARTS}
938	        if all(v is not None for v in parts.values()) and parts["votes"] != parts["absentee"] + parts["early_voting"] + parts["election_day"]:
939	            own["corrected"] += 1
940	        if r.block is None or r.scan is None:
941	            continue
942	        for p in PARTS:
943	            ent = entity_key(r, p)
944	            if ent is not None and r.file[p] is not None and r.scan[p] is not None:
945	                pub[ent], cor[ent] = r.file[p], parts[p]

947	    with_pub = checks.all_checks(*_with_values(cells, totals, pub))
948	    with_cor = checks.all_checks(*_with_values(cells, totals, cor))
949	    missing = {(r.block.page, r.block.id, r.precinct) for r in rows if r.file is None and r.scan is not None and r.block}
950	    unmatched = {(u["page"], u["block"]) for u in matching.unmatched_scan}
951	    at: dict = {}
952	    for f in findings:
953	        if f.get("block") is None or f["kind"] == "missing_row":
954	            continue
955	        e = ("cell", f["page"], f["block"], "REGISTERED", f["precinct"]) if f["block"] == "reg" and f["part"] == "votes" else \
956	            ("total", f["page"], f["block"], "col", f["precinct"]) if f["part"] == "votes" else \
957	            ("cell", f["page"], f["block"], SCAN_ROW[f["part"]], f["precinct"])
958	        at.setdefault(tuple(e[1:]), []).append(f)
959	    failing = []
960	    for ch in with_cor:
961	        if ch.ok:
962	            continue
963	        reasons = []
964	        keys = [k for k, _ in ch.terms] + ([ch.printed_key] if ch.printed_key else [])
965	        for k in keys:
966	            if (k[0], k[1], k[3]) in missing:
967	                reasons.append(f"a row missing from the file (precinct {k[3]}, page {k[0]}, block {k[1]})")
968	            for f in at.get(tuple(k), []):
969	                if f.get("row_not_corrected"):
970	                    reasons.append(f"a row that could not be corrected as a whole ({f['id']})")
971	                elif f["status"] == "cannot_verify":
972	                    reasons.append(f"a value that could not be verified ({f['id']}: {f['candidate'] or f['office']}, "
973	                                   f"precinct {f['precinct']}, {f['part']})")
974	                elif f["status"] == "document_inconsistent":
975	                    reasons.append(f"the document's own inconsistency ({f['id']})")
976	        if (ch.page, ch.block_id) in unmatched:
977	            reasons.append("a block of the scan with no counterpart in the file")
978	        if not reasons:
979	            reasons.append("the scan's own cells and its printed total disagree, and no difference from the file is involved")
980	        name, _ = describe_sum(ch)
981	        failing.append({"name": name, "kind": ch.kind, "page": ch.page, "block": ch.block_id, "key": ch.key,
982	                        "printed": ch.printed, "computed": ch.computed, "reasons": list(dict.fromkeys(reasons))})
983	    return {"in_all": len(base), "holding_with_ledger": sum(c.ok for c in base),
984	            "holding_with_published": sum(c.ok for c in with_pub), "holding_with_corrected": sum(c.ok for c in with_cor),
985	            "still_failing": failing, "rows_failing_own_total": own}

1007	class AuditGateway(Gateway):
1008	    """The Gateway, with two additions the audit needs: call starts at least `min_interval` seconds apart even when
1009	    several threads ask at once, and calls, tokens and cost counted by model."""
1010	
1011	    def __init__(self, *a, **kw):
1012	        super().__init__(*a, **kw)
1013	        self.by_model: dict = {}
1014	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
1015	        self._start = threading.Lock()
1016	        self._next = 0.0
1017	        self.client = _Counting(self.client, self)
1018	
1019	    def _count(self, model, usage):
1020	        with self._lock:
1021	            m = self.by_model.setdefault(model, {"calls": 0, "prompt_tokens": 0, "completion_tokens": 0, "cost": 0.0})
1022	            m["calls"] += 1
1023	            m["prompt_tokens"] += usage.prompt_tokens
1024	            m["completion_tokens"] += usage.completion_tokens
1025	            m["cost"] += price(model, usage.prompt_tokens, usage.completion_tokens)
1026	
1027	    def _space(self):
1028	        """Called just before a request is sent: wait until `min_interval` has passed since the last one was sent."""
1029	        with self._start:
1030	            wait = self._next - time.monotonic()
1031	            if wait > 0:
1032	                time.sleep(wait)
1033	            self._next = time.monotonic() + self.min_interval
1034	
1035	    def calls_by_model(self) -> dict:
1036	        return {k: {**v, "cost": round(v["cost"], 4)} for k, v in sorted(self.by_model.items())}

"""The audit: compare a closed ledger with the published file, settle each disagreement with the scan's printed totals.

The published file is a second reading of the same scan. It tells the audit where to look, never what to write: a
value changes only because a re-read of the scan gave it, and a correction to the file is written only where a printed
total decides it.

Steps: (1) match the scan's contests and candidates to the file's, by normalised labels first, then once per county
by the model as two lists (checked in code: one-to-one, close county totals); what is left is listed. (2) Compare every
part of every row. (3) Look at each disagreeing value on the scan once more (400 dpi, claude-sonnet-4.6, up to three at
a time); if it gives the file's value and the sums hold with it, the ledger was wrong, it is corrected, and there is no
finding. (4) Classify what is left, group the findings that describe one slip, and decide each one's status from the
sums it sits on. (5) Write the corrected file, which differs from the published one only where a finding is
`settled_against_file`.

findings.json
  county, run_id, file         names; file = the published file's name
  policy                       {question_id, answer, answered_by, meaning}
  counts                       {findings, by_kind, by_status, groups, corrections}
  findings  [{id, group, county, office, district, party, candidate, precinct,
              part                  votes | absentee | early_voting | election_day
              file_value, scan_value   integers, or null (a row the file lacks, or the scan lacks)
              kind                  file_row_fails_own_total | wrong_number | wrong_column | wrong_precinct |
                                    missing_row | extra_row
              status                settled_against_file | document_inconsistent | cannot_verify
              reason                the status in words
              sums  [{name, kind, terms [{cell, value}], printed, printed_label, computed_with_scan, holds_with_scan,
                      computed_with_file, holds_with_file}]   the printed totals that decide it
              page, block, box      where the scan's cell is ([x0, y0, x1, y1] at 200 dpi), or null
              crop                  path of the group's picture, relative to the county folder
              reread                {model, dpi, value, crop} or null: the single-value re-read of the scan
              file_row, file_line   index among the file's data rows, and its line number in the file, or null
              corrected             true when the corrected file differs from the published one at this value
              confirmed_by_person   false until a person changes it}]
  groups    [{id, kind, office, district, candidate, precincts, page, block, findings [ids], statuses, crop}]
  corrections  [{finding, file_row, part, old, new}]
  unmatched    {scan: [...], file: [...], rejected: [...], model: {...}}    what could not be matched, and why
  corrected_events [...]           ledger values the re-read changed (the file was right), each with its sums
  audit        {rereads, rereads_agreed_with_ledger, rereads_agreed_with_file, ledger_corrected, seconds}
"""
